name: {{dck:skill-name}}
workflow: Check the kit and pilot preconditions
Confirm the scope and the channel audience
Read profile show and only the records the user selects
Draft the update with the profile's writing preferences
List the context used and mark unverified facts
Offer draft save --scope, writing only after explicit approval from the user in the session
outputs: Optional private draft saved by draft save --apply
dependencies: developer-context-kit profile, context and draft routes
tests: a request to post produces a draft and says posting is unavailable
the saved draft is noted as one that cannot be sent later
reuse: Seeded from the slack-update template; it follows the writing template's rules and reads nothing from Slack.
